features.name: buying_z
features.description: Scale-normalized buying price (z-score) for distance computation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Equalizes feature scale so KNN distance is not dominated by raw integer encoding.

features.name: maint_z
features.expected_model_benefit: Balances contribution of maintenance dimension in Euclidean distance.

features.name: safety_z
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes safety axis to comparable variance for neighborhood geometry.

features.name: persons_z
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents persons dimension underweighting in distance metric.

features.name: cost_pressure
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a cost-axis similarity dimension that groups financially similar cars.

features.name: utility_score
features.description: Combined practical utility score from persons, lug_boot, and safety.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups rows with similar usability profile for nearest-neighbor lookup.

features.name: dist_to_low_safety_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance to a generic low-safety, low-capacity prototype (origin reference point).
features.expected_model_benefit: Anchors rows to a reference geometry to enhance neighbor discrimination.

features.name: dist_to_premium_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance to a generic premium-feature prototype (max values across attributes).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a complementary anchor improving radial neighborhood structure.
features.formula: np.sqrt((3 - buying)**2 + (3 - maint)**2 + (2 - safety)**2 + (2 - persons)**2 + (2 - lug_boot)**2)

features.name: safety_persons_synergy
features.description: Multiplicative interaction capturing usable-capacity coupled with safety.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear coupling that improves KNN local separability.

features.name: is_unusable_cluster
features.description: Cluster indicator for rows where persons=0 or safety=0 (structurally unusable cars).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a hard geometric partition aiding neighbor purity.

features.name: cost_utility_gap
features.description: Difference between cost burden and utility score, indicating value imbalance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a signed axis along which similar value-propositions cluster.

features.name: overall_quality_judgment
features.description: Heuristic ordinal quality judgment combining safety dominance, capacity adequacy, and affordability into a 0-4 scale, where higher means a more attractive car profile based purely on row attributes without supervised information.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a coarse semantic axis along which neighbors with similar overall desirability cluster, improving KNN locality.
